description: A wagon model -> what each of its parts is to the engine (convention.ModelParts). input: obj (OBJ text), textured (materials with a texture) and/or mtl (MTL text: a material whose map_Kd stays in the pack from the folder of model.obj has one), model (the wagon model declaration: bogies, skip, handbrake), anim_<door> (the .anim of door <door>: its objects with a frame move with it). expected: parts (per part in file order: object, place HIDDEN/SKIPPED/UNTEXTURED/BODY/INTERIOR/BOGIE/WHEEL/ANIMATED/DOOR_LEAF/CONTROL/COUPLER, front, owner, index in its list, light [group, fullbright, interior, invert]), light_groups, bogies (pivot_z; wheels: object, axle_obj [x, y] OBJ frame, center [y, z] bogie-local, radius), controls and door_leaves (key, kind, group, label, flags, offset, range, interior, pivot, axis, degrees, slide, box_min, box_max), doors (id, objects), couplers (front, shown, pivot), lamps (at, group, invert), headlights (at, dir_z, radius, rgb, group, invert), dropped_groups, skipped. Places in the model frame, as floats.

cases.note: HIDE drops a part but a WIDGET and a coupler head; CARGO_FILL and the model's skip drop
a material without a texture isn't drawn, a control's hinge marker still counts
pivots from the frames (wheelsets and HIDE aside); a wheelset's untextured part counts for its axle
the model's bogies: the first and the last pivot
objects an .anim names move with its door: not a bogie's, not a track without frames, not untextured
one control of every object of its key: flags from any, the first ROT object the hinge, the box of the drawn faces
a widget the model names in handbrake is the handbrake wheel; a control without a drawn face is none
a DOOR_<n> with a ROT marker or a TL slide is a leaf, one without is body
the pivot of an end's heads: centre line, mid-height, inner end
a head named a control too is drawn as the control, yet its faces size its end's pivot
groups are numbered as the drawn parts first name them; LINVERT and FULLBRIGHT per part
a glowing island of a group that lights something inside is a cabin lamp: not the buffer's, not a dial, not a control's
a front lamp shines forward from its front face, a rear one back; colour, group, LINVERT
a group past 32 characters is dropped: an inverted headlight shines always, the other is none
the INTERIOR prefix and token read the raw name, the light group the name without .001
the example pack's shunter as the engine reads it
the example pack's coach as the engine reads it
